desc: Ideation and problem analysis: reduce feasibility to checking max_{i in [L, L+K-1]} (nxt[i]-i) <= M-K, where nxt[i] is the first index with A[j] >= 2*A[i].
Parse N, sorted A[1..N], Q, and all (L,R) queries using 0-indexing internally.
Precompute d[i] = nxt[i] - i via bisect_left (A is sorted), with INF if no valid j exists.
Build a sparse table over d for O(1) range maximum queries.
For each query, binary search K in [0, (R-L+1)//2] with feasibility max_d(L, L+K-1) <= (R-L+1)-K.
Output each answer K on its own line.
Test against both sample inputs and edge cases: no possible pairs, all elements equal, K=0, and maximum K (both public samples PASSED).
